title: list_services input
description: Input for `list_services`. On `live` only — PR 16 scope; PR 11/13 will route the value through the snapshot manager.

snapshot.description: Snapshot id (`live` for the in-process view; PR 11 surfaces named snapshots)

repo.description: Optional: pin the listing to one repo (every listed service must live there)

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor (base64url of `{v:1, after, q}`). Reused with different args → `cursor_mismatch`.
